messages:
maria: Quick sync 2324 need compact competitive hooks for webinar24 focus: cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors. Iterate here.
ton y: +1. Deliverables: 3 email hooks, 4 one-liners, 3 objection replies, 2 webinar titles.
sarah: Drafting. Key claim: 'Unified serving for predictable latency & unit cost across hosted->dedicated->private.' Short: 'Predictable inference, no model lock-in.'
jensen: For cloud rebut: 'They manage models; we manage inference economics.' Add graceful degradation/fallback line.
sarah: Copyable set: One-liners: 'Run the models you want, at the price and latency your app needs.' 'Inference that behaves predictably across hosted, reserved, and private.' 'Ship LLM features without building a custom runtime.' 'Reduce per-token cost with batching, caching, and smart routing.'
SDR hooks (subjects): 'Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency' 'Predictable latency for real-time LLM features' 'Stop building inference infra 24 start shipping features'
Webinars: 'Serving LLMs in Production: Cost, Latency, and Reliability Playbook' 'From Prototype to Production: Inference Strategies That Scale'
Objection handlers: 'Managed endpoints simplify access but can mean variable latency and cost; Redwood adds predictable economics and dedicated SLAs.' 'Self-hosting gives control but ops burden; Redwood offers private deploy + runtime engineering and rollout tooling.' 'Model freshness? Redwood supports rapid model swaps and pinned versions at serving time.'
jensen: Competitor matrix blurb for slides: 'Cloud AI platforms: model catalog ✓ | predictable latency ✗ | private deploy ✗; LLM APIs: fastest install ✓ | variable cost ✗ | limited rollout control ✗; Infra vendors: control ✓ | ops overhead ✗ | productized SRE ✗; Redwood: balanced — model access, predictable latency, private option, rollout + observability ✓✓'
maria: Demo callouts: live latency dashboard + token-level cost breakdown; canary rollouts + automated fallback; KV/prefix caching demo showing 3x token cost reduction on repetitive queries.
sarah: Inbound routing rules: click pricing -> Field AE; self-host/reg terms -> Enterprise AE + SE; high-usage trials -> SDR outreach with cost/latency report.
maria: Compliance note: avoid absolutes like 'lowest' or 'cheapest' use qualifying language.
ops-bot: Reminder webinar 2025-06-12 10:00 UTC. Auto-create recording + follow-up pipeline.
maria: Thread closed for now — slide copy next.
